name: King Awowogei
tagline: The monkey king rules Ape Atoll with a heavy fist and a heavier crown.

abilities.name: BANANARANG
abilities.description: A comically large banana boomerang that sweeps out in a rounded trapezoid, striking every enemy it passes.

abilities.name: ROYAL DASH
abilities.description: The king blinks a short distance along the ground, leaving his enemies behind.

abilities.name: KING'S DECREE
abilities.description: A royal decree restores health and shields the king for a few seconds.

abilities.name: TRIAL BY COMBAT
abilities.description: A barrier traps the king and an enemy champion. Monkey subjects hurl banana peels that strip armor until one of them falls.
